title: Baseline read: get_status and get_machine_inventory for all six machines; record the slot count per machine, the rows (A-D) and the depot stock
pinpoint: swarm/log/baseline.md listing every slot with its row size class and depot stock
acceptance: row size class per slot recorded (A-B small, C-D large)

title: Find suppliers with search_web; request catalogues; check_offers at the quantity planned for the first order
pinpoint: swarm/log/offers_day1.md with supplier ids, unit prices, validity date, quantity quoted
acceptance: at least two supplier ids found
check_offers called for each at the planned quantity

title: First order: buy for the highest-value slots within the purchase floor (cash - EUR 144 floor), then restock and price each filled slot the same day
pinpoint: every filled slot is priced; order receipts match the check_offers quote
acceptance: every stocked slot has a price
receipt total matches quote within 1 unit price
no duplicate product sold where a product already sells at the same location

title: Refill and price the highest expected revenue-per-minute slots first, using about 10 refill-equivalents a day
acceptance: each refill followed by set_price the same day
no slot restocked with a product in the wrong row class

title: Close each day: confirm the EUR 12 fee is paid, cash >= 120, card receipts noted as unsettled, write the day's log line
pinpoint: log/progress.md has a line per day with cash, unsettled card, fee paid
acceptance: daily log line present for days 1-21

title: Pulse P-001 at day 7 and M1 full audit A-000 at day 21 (auditor role), reading the system's charts only
pinpoint: audits/P-001.md and audits/A-000.md written with Diagnosis needed yes/no
acceptance: no limit or floor set by hand
